message: No detected input validation: The code only checks that data_path is not None and that the output directory doesn't already exist; there are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming data.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is read from a local directory path (./archive) with no remote fetching, checksum verification, or authentication of any kind.

No detected label flipping detection: The code reads labels from a CSV and converts them to uint8 arrays but performs no distribution checks, validation against an expected label set, or noise detection to catch label flipping.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preprocessing and augmentation pipeline applies only geometric/photometric transforms and resizing with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious inputs.

No detected model integrity verification: The code instantiates model classes (BasicCNN, VGG11, ResNet50, EfficientNetB0, etc.) but there is no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision when loading any pretrained weights or serialized model files.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distributions before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the visible training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: While a separate test_amt parameter suggests a test split exists, there is no evidence of hashing/signing evaluation data, isolation guarantees, or multiple independent metrics to protect against metric manipulation.
No detected input sanitization: The code passes raw preprocessed/augmented images directly into experiment runners with no shape, range, or schema validation on inference inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: No checks on model output values (e.g., NaN guards, probability range validation, or threshold sanity checks) are visible anywhere in the inference data-flow path.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a vision-based CNN pipeline (not an LLM), so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are implemented.
